description: Neurosymbolic League of Legends drafting coach: deterministic engine decides (one counter-pick + one synergy-pick with source-tagged traces), OP.GG-derived YAML knowledge graph explains, and a grounded chat agent adapts fuzzy input, orchestrates the engine's tools, and narrates results without hallucinating (the LLM never decides). In-house AWS-Step-Functions-style workflow for traceability of both the draft pipeline and the agent's tool-loop.

features.name: Deterministic engine
features.description: Pure engine: DraftState, counter scoring and synergy scoring over the knowledge graph + snapshot, one counter-pick + one synergy-pick, every point emitted as a source-tagged TraceLine. Unit tests on a fixture snapshot.
features.evidence: src/lolcoach/engine/{draft_state,trace,scoring,explain}.py. evaluate_draft(ontology, state) returns exactly one counter-pick and one synergy-pick, de-duplicated, each with TraceLine(source,text,delta) per contributing relation; deterministic tie-break by slug then role order; honours open_roles and excludes picked/banned champions; DraftState.problems() validates boards. features.name: Workflow state machine
features.description: In-house Step-Functions-style executor (Task/Choice/Succeed/Fail), immutable event store write-through per transition, draft-eval workflow, execution history API, tests for gapless ordered history and STATE_FAILED-with-traceback.
features.evidence: src/lolcoach/workflow/{types,events,ddl,store,executor}.py + workflows/draft_eval.py. Workflow.validate() rejects unknown next / missing terminal; WorkflowExecutor rejects unregistered task/predicate keys. Executor writes every event through to data/executions.db (executions + execution_events, UNIQUE(execution_id,seq)); on a raising task it emits STATE_FAILED with traceback then EXECUTION_FAILED and status=failed. draft-eval pipeline: ValidateDraft -> IsValid -> LoadKnowledge -> BuildCandidates -> ScoreCounters -> ScoreSynergies -> AssembleTrace -> PicksExist -> Succeeded/DraftInvalid/NoPicks. Live run (real graph, allies=[jinx] enemies=[ahri,vi,leona]) -> succeeded, 19 gapless events (seq 1..19), preserved to store; counter Qiyana, synergy Twisted Fate. Tests (9): test_workflow.py. ruff + mypy clean; 49 tests total pass. (History HTTP endpoints land with the api milestone.)

features.name: Grounded narrator
features.description: Provider-neutral LangChain client (Claude/OpenAI) whose input is engine/tool output; narrate() explains one recommendation, narrate_final() a whole agent tool-loop; system prompt forbids any fact/number absent from the input; unsourced_champions() grounding guard. narrate_final() requires a model client (LlmUnavailableError otherwise) so agent chat never fabricates an answer; narrate() (draft-eval) keeps the deterministic offline fallback.
features.evidence: src/lolcoach/agent/{llm,narrator}.py. agent/llm.py is a provider-neutral client (LlmMessage/LlmReply/ImagePart, provider-native vision blocks) selected by LOL_COACH_LLM_PROVIDER; build_client() returns None without a key. LOL_COACH_LLM_EXTRA_HEADERS (JSON object) is forwarded via default_headers so the client can reach a gateway/proxy that requires headers (verified against a local OpenCode gateway needing x-opencode-session). narrate_final() requires a client and raises LlmUnavailableError when none is configured, the call fails, or the reply is blank; it applies unsourced_champions(text, allowed, ontology): any known champion in the reply that appears in no tool result is discarded in favour of offline_final_text(). narrate() still falls back to offline_text. Tests (11): tests/test_narrator.py (offline names picks + cites only record numbers, empty record, offline final summarizes suggest_pick, fallback without evidence, guard ignores allowed sources, narrate_final requires a client, narrate_final propagates a model failure) + tests/test_config_env.py (extra-headers JSON parse / malformed ignored / headers forwarded). ruff + mypy clean.

features.name: Chat agent (adapter + orchestration)
features.description: Chat-first front door: an agent that turns fuzzy human input (shorthand, typos, prose, a draft image) into the engine's strict input, orchestrates the deterministic tools (set_board, suggest_pick, explain_matchup, get_champion) as a traced workflow tool-loop (<=8 round-trips), and narrates the result. The LLM never decides picks.
features.evidence: src/lolcoach/agent/{tools,agent}.py + workflow/workflows/agent_chat.py + POST /api/agent/chat. Tools: set_board resolves aliases/typos/casing via NameResolver; suggest_pick wraps the pure engine and is the ONLY pick source; explain_matchup/get_champion return evidence. choose_action runs the LLM tool-loop; there is NO offline planner: a missing client or a failing model call raises LlmUnavailableError and fails the Think state, so the execution is marked failed and no answer is returned (test_missing_client_fails_the_think_step, test_model_error_fails_the_think_step). The loop is a workflow (ParseInput -> Think -> Route -> RunTool -loop-> Finalize | MaxSteps) so the Trace Inspector shows the agent's exact call journey. Tests (16): tests/test_agent_tools.py (9) + tests/test_agent_loop.py (7: fuzzy parse + advised pick, gapless call journey, tool-budget MaxSteps, missing client fails Think, model error fails Think, unsourced-champion discard, guard unit). Live end-to-end (real proxy, 2026-10-15): POST /api/agent/chat {"message":"jinx vs their zeri, who should we pick?"} -> HTTP 200, status=succeeded, mode=llm, tool_calls=[set_board, suggest_pick, explain_matchup], grounded reply. ruff + mypy clean; 91 tests total pass.
